name: CatStudio Asset - Character Catalog -
summary:
Experience each character in VR and AR.

CatStudio Asset - Character Catalog - is a viewer for the 3D character assets created by CatStudio, in VR and AR.
Walk around life-size characters to see every detail, and switch motions to watch them move.

Included characters (7 total):
- Monsters series: Gnome / Cyclops / Evil Knight / Golem / Mummy / Goblin / Orc

Features:
- Life size: Walk around full-scale characters and inspect them up close
